body.p: The person Pereden left to set up a fish trap. Having set up the fish trap, Pereden was sitting near the fish trap. Unyangan [GVY:] shot Pereden when he was sitting. Pereden fell into the fish trap. Unyangan killed him and left.Peredene is most probably PeredenwÉ. He went and met an elk. "What do you eat?" "I eat willows." Unyangan said: "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan left and looked for bears. He met a bear: "What do you eat, bear?" "I eat mice, I eat elks, I eat ants." Unyangan left to search for a wolf. He met a wolf: "What do you eat, wolf?" "I eat reindeer, humans, dogs." "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan left, he went to search for a black grouse. He found a black grouse: "What do you eat?" "I eat berries." "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan left, he searched for a fox, he found a fox. "Fox, what do you eat?" "I eat hare, mice." "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan said and left. He met a partridge: "What do you eat?" "I eat willows, berries." "Grow from birth [grow up]!" Unyangan left, looked for a hazel grouse, he found a hazel grouse: "What do you eat?" "I eat willows, cowberries, bearberries." Unyangan left, he looked for a human: "What do you eat?" "I eat bread." "Grow from birth [grow up]!" Unyangan said, left and found a horse: "What do you eat?" "I eat grass." "Grow from birth [grow up]!" Unyangan left, he looked for a cow. He found a cow: "What do you eat?" "I eat grass." "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan left, he found a reindeer: "What do you eat?" "I eat lichen, grass, mushrooms." "Grow from birth [=grow up]!" Unyangan left and looked for a dog. He found a dog: "What do you eat?" "I eat skins, bread, meat." "Grow from birth [=grow up!]", Unyangan said, went away to look for a lynx. He found a lynx: "What do you eat?" "I eat reindeer, I eat you." The lynx ate Unyangan.
